evals.prompt: Review PR #136 in audit mode. I may be checked out on another branch.
evals.expected_output: The review resolves PR #136 to immutable base/head SHAs instead of substituting the current checkout, reads dev/AGENTS.md, reports target identity, makes no edits, and rechecks that the PR head did not move before the verdict.
assertions: The response records an exact base SHA and head SHA for PR #136.
The response does not treat the current checkout as the PR target unless it proves they match.
The response states or demonstrates that dev/AGENTS.md was used as project grounding.
The final verdict is explicitly scoped to the resolved exact head.

evals.prompt: Review my current changes. No PR or branch scope specified.
evals.expected_output: The review resolves the repository default branch, merge-base and current HEAD; includes committed branch changes plus staged, unstaged and relevant untracked changes; and reports dirty/clean state before giving a verdict.
assertions: The response defines a base SHA and current head SHA.
The response accounts for staged, unstaged, and relevant untracked changes.
The response records working-tree state rather than assuming it is clean.

evals.prompt: Auto-fix the issues in PR #136, but do not change branches or commit anything.
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves PR #136 first and edits only if the current writable checkout matches the PR head. Otherwise it fails closed with a target/write-state mismatch. If it edits, it records before/after target state and re-reviews the post-fix state without committing.
assertions: The response never edits an unrelated checkout.
The response distinguishes the pre-fix and post-fix reviewed state.
The response does not commit or push.

evals.prompt: Review only statgpu/linear_model for the changes on my branch.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats the path as a filter on a branch/working-tree target, still resolves immutable base/head identity, and does not mistake the path itself for the comparison base.
assertions: The response records the branch/working-tree base and head identity.
The response applies statgpu/linear_model as a path filter.

evals.expected_output: The project skill treats --fix as auto-fix, resolves PR #136 exactly before editing, posts or attempts to post the final summary only because --comment was explicitly supplied, and does not interpret --comment as permission to merge or make unrelated repository changes.
assertions: --fix has the same mutation semantics as auto-fix.
--comment is scoped to the resolved PR review summary.
The response does not treat --comment as merge or branch-mutation authorization.
